note: League Discord, hand-curated 2026-09-11 for the Season Forecast. Every text is VERBATIM and was re-checked against the raw message (the Aug-5 archive export or a read-only GET of the message by id). Good-natured material only; nothing from private or admin channels.

quotes.text: Can the bot give us preseason predictions for the league? Forecast?

quotes.text: I was promised a season preview. I am prepared to be torn apart.

quotes.text: The last remaining team is gonna be stacked at times, hence being picked last.
